import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd()
def save(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
prov=json.loads(Path('provenance-initial.json').read_text())
for p in prov:
 raw=Path(f"originals/{p['id']}.jsonl").read_bytes();s=raw.decode();m=re.search(r'"statement"\s*:\s*',s);statement,end=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(s[m.end():]);token=s[m.end():m.end()+end].encode();p.update(raw_line_utf8=s,raw_statement_token=token.decode(),raw_statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),decoded_statement=statement,decoded_statement_utf8_sha256=hashlib.sha256(statement.encode()).hexdigest());assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256']
save('original-provenance.json',json.dumps(prov,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
a=json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text());acc=json.loads(Path('history-access.json').read_text());bad=[x['path'] for x in acc if a[x['path']]!=x['sha256']];assert not bad;print('All historical read hashes agree',len(acc))
save('manual-unavailable.json',json.dumps({'records':[{'identity':'Original OddCycleOfLargeChromaticNumber problem webpage','url':'https://mathweb.ucsd.edu/~erdosproblems/erdos/newproblems/OddCycleOfLargeChromaticNumber.html','reason':'TLS certificate verification failure; guard unavailable seq3; all alternate deliveries of this artifact forbidden'},{'identity':'ErdosProblems881 current problem page','url':'https://www.erdosproblems.com/881','reason':'challenge-platform at byte30497; transport200 guard success unchanged; page unavailable across all alternate deliveries, not used for scientific gates'}],'network_policy_breach_observed':False},indent=2))
save('search3-plan.json',json.dumps({'queries':['"Svyable" "Infinite deletions" additive bases pdf','"clique transversal" "151" proof','"odd cycle" "640" "proof" chromatic']}))
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'charge_search.py'),str(L/'search3-plan.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout);assert r.returncode==0
